blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Nearly 25,000 children under age 5 across Cebu were classified as stunted in 2025, with four local government units recording prevalence rates of at least 17 percent, according to data released by the Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2).
